text: They are very messy.. These arrived in an envelope smashed flat. When you open them up they shed numerous things all over the place. Things that are in the flower arrangement aren't stable. They fall off all over the place. They also look pretty fake..

features: Home and Outdoor Decoration: Decorate your room, porch, veranda & yard in a gorgeous and classy way, hanging on the window and wall. Perfect for home, garden, dining table, kitchen, Fence wall, office and wedding decoration.

Specification: Total 6 bunches with 3 colors, 2 bunches each color, 7 branches each bunch. The length is around 13.5 inch and diameter is around 9 inch each bunch. Fitting nicely in a medium size vase to make a very big bouquet.

Material: Silk with plastic injection. The product is made of healthy and environmental materials. It's not easy to fade or fall. The stem is injected with steel wire inside,easy to bend and adjust as required.
Easy Store & Clean: High temperature & UV resistance. It is recommended to clean regularly with cold wind by hair dryer. Suggest to place in a vase or any outdoor arrangement for better decoration.

Attention: The flowers might be squeezed together after receiving, Please kindly understand this is normal due to transportation. Please refer to the picture or video to extend the branches easily. The leaves, stem and branches are removable, detachable and extended. Please simply re-assemble them if some flowers fell down. Vase not included.
